confirmDelete.desc: Ask for confirmation before moving items to the Recycle Bin or deleting them.

windowsSelection.label: Windows-style mouse selection
windowsSelection.desc: A click selects only that file and clears other marks, Shift+click selects the range, a click on empty space clears everything. Otherwise like Total Commander: a click only moves the cursor.

jumpInNewTab.desc: Quick jump (Ctrl+P) opens the chosen item in a new tab of the same group. Ctrl+Enter does the opposite.
